name: Ore ga Kikasareta Tsuma no Netorare Kokuhaku ~Nee Anata, Watashi Ima... Tottemo Shiawase yo~
original_name: 俺が聞かされた妻の寝取られ告白 ～ねえあなた、わたし今……とっても幸せよ～
source:
A married couple, the Tayamas, took a vacation to a hot spring resort to celebrate their wedding anniversary. The husband was completely smitten with his curvy and beautiful wife, Mina, as he guided her around. The innkeeper suggested they try the beauty massage service offered by the inn.

Mina had been struggling with her husband's one-sided assumptions and poor sexual skills, but she intended to endure it all. However, the masseur, Miyamoto, sensed Mina's distress and skillfully released her pent-up frustration through pleasure.

Miyamoto exposed Mina's hidden lustful side, and during their trip, he would call her away for lewd encounters. These encounters became increasingly intense, and eventually—

"For couples struggling with sexual issues, please visit our inn. We will help you discover a new form of marital bliss!"

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1044773]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
一对已婚夫妇田山夫妇去温泉度假村度假庆祝结婚纪念日。当丈夫带着他那曲线优美、美丽的妻子米娜四处走动时，他完全被她迷住了。客栈老板建议他们试试客栈提供的美容按摩服务。

米娜一直在与丈夫片面的假设和糟糕的性技巧作斗争，但她打算忍受这一切。然而，按摩师宫本察觉到了米娜的苦恼，巧妙地通过愉悦来释放她压抑已久的沮丧。

宫本暴露了米娜隐藏的好色的一面，在旅途中，他会因猥亵遭遇而将她叫走。这些遭遇变得越来越激烈，最终——

“正在为性问题苦苦挣扎的夫妻，请来我们的客栈，我们将帮助你发现新的婚姻幸福形式！”
